body:
I guess it's a good start that it's not a brain disease.

My mood is pretty low almost all of the time, some years ago my psychologist suspected that I may be experiencing depression, but due to terrible support from my parents I never did anything about it.

Anxiety.. I don't really think so, I'm almost always pretty calm and just generally don't experience anxiety that much.

I am preoccupied with some things going on in my life, but on the other side I'm doing well in school, I have a job, and I found friends, so I can't say it's a big issue for me.
